## Problem
What problem does this solve? Why is it needed?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the feature. How should it work?

## Security Considerations
Does this feature touch authentication, permissions, credentials, or agent communication? If so, describe the security implications.

## Alternatives Considered
What other approaches did you consider? Why is this one better?
